name: impeccable-legacy
notes: Pinned on purpose to the last commit BEFORE upstream consolidated these 21 skills into one /impeccable skill (f683f413, then b0f44f8). Keeps the /animate, /polish, /frontend-design... names our skills and workflows call. Repo is ~380 MB: installer uses shallow + blob-filtered + sparse fetch.

name: impeccable
notes: Current upstream (main HEAD): single /impeccable skill with ~20 sub-commands. Optional (-All / -Only impeccable); overlaps impeccable-legacy.

name: taste-skill
notes: Anti-slop frontend direction. Upstream also ships as a Claude Code plugin (namespaced taste-skill:*); here linked as plain skills.

name: gsap-skills
notes: Official GreenSock skills. Do not mix GSAP with framer-motion in the same project.

name: motion-design
notes: LottieFiles official. Implementation-agnostic motion criteria (timing, easing, choreography).

name: wondelai-design
notes: Book-based design skills (top-level folders of the repo).

name: wondelai-strategy
notes: Book-based positioning/messaging skills. Same repo+ref as wondelai-design, separate sparse checkout.

name: marketingskills
notes: Upstream renamed skills: product-marketing-context -> product-marketing, page-cro -> cro, launch-strategy -> launch, social-content -> social. Old names do not exist at this ref.

name: anthropic-design
notes: Each folder carries its own Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt. artifacts-builder was renamed upstream to web-artifacts-builder. anthropics' frontend-design is NOT linked by default because impeccable-legacy ships a skill with the same name.

name: anthropic-document-skills
notes: LICENSE.txt: use governed by your own agreement with Anthropic; forbids retaining copies outside the Services, copying and redistribution. This installer NEVER clones or links them. Get them through your own plan: claude.ai (built into file creation) or Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills. No sanctioned route for Codex.

name: ui-ux-pro-max
notes: Includes its data/ and scripts/ (Python) inside the skill folder. Same repo also has banner-design, brand, design, design-system, slides, ui-styling (not linked).

name: excalidraw-diagram
notes: Real source (per ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json). Repo reachable, SKILL.md at root, but no license = all rights reserved. Excluded from default; -Only excalidraw-diagram installs it for personal use at your own risk.

name: gstack
notes: Has its own installer (needs Bun; generates per-host skills). Do not clone pieces. Claude Code: git clone --single-branch --depth 1 https://github.com/garrytan/gstack.git ~/.claude/skills/gstack && cd ~/.claude/skills/gstack && ./setup   Codex/others: clone to ~/gstack and run ./setup --host codex

name: threejs-graphics
notes: 862 stars, MIT, last push 2026-09-22. Procedural Three.js graphics (router + 23 techniques). Some bundled assets carry their own THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. Repo ~130 MB (sparse fetch). Opt-in: -All or -Only threejs-graphics.

name: shader-for-interfaces
notes: 115 stars, MIT, last push 2026-09-01. Decides CSS/SVG/Canvas vs WebGL/WebGPU and builds contained GPU effects in UIs (Three.js/GLSL/WGSL). Small, young project. Opt-in.
